verdict.rationale: Maritime is an agent-hosting and automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents versions, diffs or review of agent and trigger definitions, or rollback to a prior deployment. Building from GitHub repos relies on git's own versioning, a host-platform capability. Append-only session logs record runs, not automation definitions, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
